summary: CapsoVision filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing FDA clearance, granted September 25, 2026, of AI Highlights, its AI-assisted reading feature for the CapsoCam Plus small bowel capsule endoscopy system. The September 28, 2026 press release, attached as Exhibit 99.1, states the tool flags suspected abnormal lesions in patients over two years old studied for suspected small bowel bleeding, integrating with CapsoView and CapsoCloud. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics were disclosed. This is a routine product-regulatory milestone rather than a special situation; watch commercial adoption and reimbursement.
